case: Direct domain-over-enum query operators under a shadowed search_path
change: Expand the same-named domain and leaf-enum collision fixture to cover direct bound comparison operators against the target schema's qualified leaf enum.
contract: With same-named enum and domain definitions in two schemas and search_path selecting the shadow schema, target-schema catalog metadata remains qualified to the target leaf enum.
Direct text parameters work for equality, inequality, ordering comparisons, IN, NOT IN and BETWEEN against the target leaf enum.
IS DISTINCT FROM with a text value and IS NOT DISTINCT FROM with SQL NULL produce exact PostgreSQL NULL-safe row results.
Every direct operator result retains the target domain type and exact label/NULL values; shadow rows and siblings remain unchanged.
independent_oracle: PostgreSQL row IDs, labels, SQL NULL, pg_typeof(status)::text, current_schema(), catalog metadata, and exact shadow-table contents.
